name: lfp
description: LazyCodex extension plugin for Codex model/provider configuration and category routing guidance.
author: islee23520

interface.displayName: LFP — Full OMO Bridge for Codex
interface.shortDescription: Extends LazyCodex with model/provider setup, category routing guidance, and fallback lookup.
interface.longDescription: LFP keeps LazyCodex/OMO agents as the source of truth and focuses on model operations: provider setup, configurable primary model fields, category-based model routing guidance, interactive TUI setup, and atomic runtime promotion with rollback.
defaultPrompt: Use LFP to configure LazyCodex/OMO model routing and provider defaults.
Use the fallback guidance when a configured agent hits quota, rate-limit, or provider failure.
Keep agent behavior owned by LazyCodex/OMO; LFP only manages supported model fields and saved fallback lookup.
